privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Portify AI has no accounts and no database. Your draft lives in your browser (LocalStorage and IndexedDB).
privacy.p2: When you upload a CV, our server reads the file in memory to extract its text and does not keep the file.
privacy.p3: When AI processing is requested, the extracted text is sent to the configured AI provider (OpenAI) to produce your portfolio content. Do not upload anything you are not comfortable sharing with that provider.
privacy.p4: Exported websites are static files. They contain only what you see in the preview, with no tracking and no connection back to Portify AI.
privacy.p5: Clearing your browser data may delete locally saved drafts. Download a JSON backup to be safe.
